Definition: of Latin origin; little wells, i.e. mineral springs; Potioli (i.e. Puteoli), a place in Italy:--Puteoli.
BiblicalUsage: Puteoli is a port on the coast of Italy, and Paul's voyage ends its sea leg there. After the storm and the shipwreck, the ship puts in at Puteoli, and Paul goes on to Rome by land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God brings his servants safely to shore, and Puteoli is where the long voyage finally touches land.
